summary: Agile skirmishers who use defensive formations and strike-and-fade tactics to control the pitch.
keyStrengths: Opponents next to the Blocker can't Assist Blocks, thanks to Disruptor
Blitzer can reposition via Strike and Fade after blocking
weaknesses: Vulnerable to heavy attrition if caught static
Requires precise positioning to maximize zone control
recommendedStrategy: Use the Thrower's Sure Scoop to pick up the ball automatically, and let the Blitzer strike and slip away before opponents can retaliate.

summary: Immovable frontline wall that creates chaos by letting Goblins slip past Marking players safely.
keyStrengths: Ironhides boast heavy armor and high block dice
Goblins utilize Elusive movement to slip past enemy lines
weaknesses: Extremely low movement speed across the team
Poor throwing capability
recommendedStrategy: Form a solid, slow-marching grid with Ironhides to lock down central territory while Elusive Goblins weave through traffic to claim cards.

summary: Aggressive brawlers leveraging momentum and free actions out of mark movements.
keyStrengths: Beastkin can execute free block actions after a run and mark
Sworn Blockers provide reliable high-armor anchors
weaknesses: Lacks specialized ball-handling tools
Susceptible to being out-scored by fast-moving teams
recommendedStrategy: Drive forward into opponents using Beastkin Charges to disrupt positioning and open up scoring lanes.

summary: Opportunistic raiders capable of sudden defensive pivots and quick releases.
keyStrengths: Bloodblade exerts constant pressure with Relentless
Runner can make an immediate Quick Release pass when targeted
weaknesses: Moderate armor leaves them exposed to heavy hit chains
Requires careful management of positioning
recommendedStrategy: Bait opponents into committing blocks against your Runner to trigger safe Quick Releases, and use the Bloodblade to clean up marked zones.

summary: Stubborn defenders featuring reliable safe handling and relentless multi-block pressure.
keyStrengths: High armor and re-rollable block dice on Blitzers
Doom Seekers apply constant Relentless pressure
weaknesses: Very low movement across all positionals
Cannot easily chase down fast breakaway runners
recommendedStrategy: Control the center of the board, rely on Ball Guard to secure loose balls, and grind down opponents with steady blocks.

summary: Master aerial artists capable of exceptional passing consistency and high-speed catches.
keyStrengths: Throwers can re-roll failed throw checks via Pinpoint Passer
Catchers trigger free runs off successful throws
weaknesses: Extremely fragile armor profile
Vulnerable if pinned down in physical scuffles
recommendedStrategy: Keep the ball moving through the air with high-precision passes, using Catch and Go to rapidly gain ground.

summary: Slippery tricksters backed by a massive Oakwalker and woodland protection.
keyStrengths: Beastmaster prevents assist dice against them
Fox can move through enemy zones safely
weaknesses: Individual models lack stopping power
Fragile line prone to injuries
recommendedStrategy: Use the Oakwalker to anchor space with Colossus, while the Fox and Illusionist slip past enemy screens to grab objective cards.

summary: Swarming small players anchored by a towering Troll capable of brutal board control.
keyStrengths: Goblins can move through enemy-marked squares safely via Elusive
Troll provides dominant 2-dice blocking power
weaknesses: Terrible armor makes every injury check critical
Low individual throw stats
recommendedStrategy: Swarm open spaces to complete challenge cards easily, using the Troll to smash high-value targets out of your way.

summary: Resilient underdogs featuring emergency reserves, a sturdy Hefty, and a heavy-hitting Oakwalker.
keyStrengths: Hefty ignores shoves with Anchored
Deep bench safety via Emergency Reserves
weaknesses: Lowest collective armor ratings in the game
Poor passing distance
recommendedStrategy: Lean into your high reserve count to absorb heavy hits, protecting your Catcher so they can trigger free movement from successful throws.

summary: The ultimate versatile squad with reliable handling, catch momentum, and solid blitzing.
keyStrengths: Thrower automatically picks up loose balls
Blitzer re-rolls block dice for consistent pressure
weaknesses: Lacks elite top-tier specialization in either pure bash or dash
Average stats across the board
recommendedStrategy: Pivot your playstyle based on the challenge cards drawn—play a tight passing game against bashers, or leverage your Blitzer against fragile dash teams.

summary: Ferocious front-liners designed to force devastating armor checks through relentless multi-dice blocking.
keyStrengths: Skullreavers force opponents to take armor checks on knockdown results
Gorehorns apply aggressive Charge pressure
weaknesses: Aggressive momentum can cause players to overextend
Poor passing capabilities
recommendedStrategy: Force engagements near pitch boundaries, maximizing Skullreaver block resolution to grind down enemy resilience.

summary: Asymmetric roster pairing brick-wall Scalebrutes with fleet-footed Darter ball handlers.
keyStrengths: Scalebrutes provide immense 2-dice strength
Darters offer extreme speed and Ball Guard recovery
weaknesses: Scalebrutes struggle heavily with passing and throwing actions
Darters are fragile if isolated
recommendedStrategy: Establish a heavy Scalebrute screen to absorb hits while your Darters weave through gaps to collect and score the ball.

summary: Versatile horror squad featuring ethereal mobility, terrifying werewolf strikes, and solid anchor zombies.
keyStrengths: Wraith can phase through enemy lines via Ethereal
Werewolf can automatically injure targets on a rolled 6
weaknesses: Zombies are exceptionally slow
Requires tight synchronization between fast and slow units
recommendedStrategy: Send your Wraith and Werewolf on swift disruption runs while Flesh Golems hold down the center board.

summary: Disciplined positional controllers who dictate movement via running passes and immovable guards.
keyStrengths: Bodyguards completely deny shoves with Anchored
Thrower enables free short throws after running
weaknesses: Retainer linemen are standard and unspecialized
Lacks explosive fast-break speed
recommendedStrategy: Form tight screens using your Bodyguards to dictate board zones and protect active objective lanes.

summary: Furious raiders featuring high-impact positionals, relentless attacks, and the unique Ale Hog support unit.
keyStrengths: Ale Hog stands up adjacent prone teammates automatically
Wolfcoat and Berserker apply severe offensive pressure
weaknesses: Fragile armor profile makes prolonged brawls dangerous
Punished heavily if initial strikes miss
recommendedStrategy: Hit hard and fast, keeping the Ale Hog near your front lines to quickly cycle prone teammates back onto their feet.

summary: Pestilential attrition masters who deny enemy movement and shrug off shoves with Pustule Brutes.
keyStrengths: Pustule Brutes ignore shoves via Anchored and boast massive armor
Plaguehorns bring dynamic Charge movement options
weaknesses: Very slow movement speed across the team
Low agility makes ball retrieval difficult
recommendedStrategy: Clump up in high-density areas, forcing opponents into terrible block odds while you grind down the clock.

summary: Colossal powerhouse monsters backed by small Grublings that change engagement rules.
keyStrengths: Ogres destroy lines with Colossus dice results
Grublings stop opponents' Runs when they move alongside them
weaknesses: Low total model count
Grublings are exceptionally fragile
recommendedStrategy: Use your Ogres as unstoppable battering rams to clear pathing lanes, while Grublings absorb attention and claim scattered cards.

summary: Classic bruising squad combining reliable ball handling with heavy-hitting devastation.
keyStrengths: Bruiser turns Smash results into Flatten! via Heavy Hitter
Thrower handles ball pickup smoothly
weaknesses: Below-average passing distance and agility
Can be out-maneuvered by fast elven teams
recommendedStrategy: Systematically eliminate enemy players using your Bruiser and Blitzer, secure the ball with your Thrower, and march methodically downfield.

summary: Reliable attrition team featuring self-reviving skeletons and a heavy-hitting Mummy.
keyStrengths: Skeletons can stand up for free before actions via Undying
Mummy delivers devastating Heavy Hitter attacks
weaknesses: Linemen are exceptionally slow
Losing your Ghoul heavily hurts scoring potential
recommendedStrategy: Use the Mummy to smash opposition strongpoints while Skeletons and Zombies form an unyielding wall of attrition.

summary: Blazing fast ratfolk spearheaded by an elite Sewer Runner.
keyStrengths: Sewer Runner has Move 9 and protects the ball with Ball Guard
Highest baseline speed in the game
weaknesses: Extremely fragile armor profile across all rats
Prone to severe injuries if caught in heavy contact
recommendedStrategy: Avoid brawling entirely; use raw speed to grab loose balls and outrun opponents before they can mount a defense.

summary: Chaotic horde featuring tricksters, a bomb lobber, a vaulting bounder, and a dangerous rattle cart.
keyStrengths: Rattle Cart operates freely while Marked via Juggernaut
Spore Slinger can lob bombs at Open or Marked targets up to 3 squares away
weaknesses: Individual models have zero armor and poor stats
High risk of self-inflicted chaos
recommendedStrategy: Flood the board with cheap bodies to fulfill objective cards, using the Rattle Cart to smash high-value targets out of position.

summary: Elite stat monsters balanced by the dangerous Thirst mechanic and protective Devoted thralls.
keyStrengths: Vampires boast exceptional baseline stats across speed and block
Thralls can absorb Thirst injuries via Devoted
weaknesses: Thirst can injure your own ball carriers on missed blocks
Requires careful proximity management
recommendedStrategy: Keep your Thralls close to your vampire stars so they can soak up Thirst penalties when blocks go awry.

summary: Elite acrobatic team featuring lightning speed and free Glade Dancer sidesteps.
keyStrengths: Glade Dancers make free Sidestep actions via Dance Step
Catchers and throwers excel at rapid passing game
weaknesses: Extremely thin armor leaves no room for positional errors
Fragile front line
recommendedStrategy: Use your Glade Dancer's free sidesteps to weave past enemy screens, striking the ball carrier directly before flashing downfield.
